title: Second charge bridge rescues landlords from arrears
summary:
Specialist lender Somo has completed a £145,000 second charge bridging loan to help two portfolio landlords clear mortgage arrears and remove a title restriction. The 18-month facility was secured against a property valued at £460,000 with an existing £65,000 first charge, allowing the borrowers time to sell assets without pressure.

title: Maslow Capital provides £238m for Southwark student scheme
summary:
Maslow Capital has provided a £238 million development finance facility to a joint venture between Arada London and the Shaw Corporation for a mixed-use scheme in Southwark. The facility will fund Devonshire Place, comprising 941 purpose-built student accommodation beds and 200 affordable homes on the Old Kent Road.

title: FRP arranges £3.3m refinance for part-vacant portfolio
summary:
FRP's Real Estate Advisory team has completed a £3.3m commercial property refinance for a three-asset portfolio comprising two central London offices and an industrial property in Staffordshire, with one of the London assets currently vacant. The portfolio, valued at approximately £7.45m, secured a three-year loan at 44% loan-to-value without personal guarantees.

title: Two-year fixed mortgage rates approach 6% threshold
summary:
Average two-year fixed-rate mortgages are approaching the 6% mark, according to data from Moneyfacts, as borrowing costs continue their upward trajectory. The average two-year fixed mortgage rate now stands at 5.97%, up from 5.68% a month ago.

title: New estate agency software launches with free tier
summary:
London-based Havenswift Hosting has launched TerraSuite, an estate and letting agency software platform offering a free version with unlimited property listings. The platform went live on 6th October, providing agencies with website functionality including property listings for sales, lettings and short-term rentals.

title: Chancellor expected to limit Capital Gains Tax rise
summary:
Chancellor John Healey is expected to introduce only a modest increase in Capital Gains Tax in the upcoming Budget, stepping back from proposals that would have aligned rates with Income Tax. The decision follows warnings that significant tax increases could prompt investors to relocate capital abroad.

title: HMO tenants report safety concerns over housemate vetting
summary:
More than two out of five tenants in houses in multiple occupation move into shared accommodation with little or no information about their future housemates, according to new research. The study found that 21% have felt unsafe at some point because of a housemate.

The post HMO tenants report safety concerns over housemate vetting appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Martin & Co Huddersfield completes fourth agency acquisition
summary:
Will Taylor, franchise owner of Martin & Co Huddersfield, has completed the acquisition of independent estate and lettings agency ADM Residential, marking his fourth business purchase since 2009. The deal consolidates ADM Residential's portfolio into the Huddersfield operation, which now employs 12 staff members.

title: Rightmove integrates AI comparison tool into search results
summary:
Rightmove has integrated its AI-powered comparison assistant directly into property search result pages. The Ask Rightmove tool enables users to compare multiple properties and ask questions beyond traditional search filters, with initial data showing users spend 40% longer on the platform.
